checks: Only fresh local TSDF volumes are constructed; no mapper object is accepted or mutated.

Separate before/after native meshes determine gross new, lost and net on a fixed template basis.
Input frame hashes are unchanged and nonnegative area masses remain linear.
No source reference, scene generator, source truth, global candidate filter or score weights are imported by the operator.
limitations: Known-geometry hypothesis fixtures test the renderer/fusion/metric operator; they do not establish fitted hidden-shape forecasting or complete exploration advantage.
Future caller must construct each mutually exclusive hypothesis separately and prevent synthetic frames from entering the measured mapper.
Template basis and actual source reference must be independently generated and their areas clearly distinguished.
Fixed 8m fusion truncation matches current fixture contract; other sensors require explicit parameter adaptation.
Boolean receipt fields alone are not proof of caller data isolation.
